passive.name: Bravado
passive.description: Spellcasts empower Taric's next 2 basic attacks to deal bonus magic damage, reduce his spell cooldowns, and attack in quick succession.

spells.name: Starlight's Touch
spells.description: Heals nearby allied champions based on charges stored. Bravado-empowered attacks grant a charge of Starlight's Touch.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Gain a stack (max {{ maxcharges }}) every {{ stackcooldown }} seconds and when hitting a Bravado Attack.

Active: Consume all stacks to restore {{ healingperstack }} Health per stack to nearby ally champions ({{ maxstackhealing }} at {{ maxcharges }} stacks).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Bastion
spells.description:
Passively increase the Armor of Taric and any allied champion with Bastion.

Actively shields an ally and grants them Bastion for as long as they remain near Taric. Taric's spells also cast off the ally with Bastion.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Taric gains {{ bonusarmor }} Armor and forms a tether between him and the ally bound by this Ability. As long as they are near each other, the ally gains {{ bonusarmor }} Armor and Taric casts all his Abilities from both himself and his linked ally.

Active: Taric binds to an ally champion, granting a {{ shieldhpratio }}% max Health Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Dazzle
spells.description: Taric readies a beam of starlight that, after a brief delay, deals magic damage and stuns enemies.
spells.tooltip: Taric projects a beam of starlight, bursting after {{ chargeduration }} second to deal <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Stun</status> enemies for {{ stunduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Cosmic Radiance
spells.description: Pulses cosmic energy onto nearby allied champions after a delay, making them invulnerable for a short duration.
spells.tooltip: Taric calls down protection from the heavens. After {{ initialdelay }} seconds, nearby ally champions become invulnerable for {{ invulnduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

variants.name: Bravado
effects:
Innate: After casting an ability, Taric empowers his next two basic attacks within 5 seconds to each gain 100% total attack speed, deal 25 : 93 (based on level) (+ 15% bonus armor) bonus magic damage, and reduce the remaining cooldowns of his basic abilities by 1 : 2 (based on ability haste)
seconds.

variants.name: Starlight's Touch
effects: Starlight's Touch can heal up to a maximum of 125 (+ 75% AP) (+ 5% of Taric's maximum health) at 5 charges.

variants.name: Bastion
effects: Taric can also self-cast to shield himself; if he self-casts and is untethered, he will become tethered to the nearest ally. Similarly, if he is tethered to an ally and self-casts, both he and the ally will be shielded. Only one ally can be bound at a time, and selecting a new ally overrides the previous bind.

variants.name: Cosmic Radiance
effects: Active: Taric calls down a star from above that descends to him over 2.5 seconds. Afterwards, he and nearby allied champions become invulnerable for 2.5 seconds.

changes.title: Q - Starlight's Touch
changes.text: Heal per charge: 25 (+15% AP) (+0.75% of Taric's maximum health) ⇒ 25 (+15% AP) (+1% of Taric's maximum health)

changes.title: General
changes.text: TETHER INTERACTION: Casting R - Cosmic Radiance , E - Dazzle , and W - Bastion on Taric's linked ally that is not present on the map will no longer channel, show their VFX, or grant benefits, respectively, on them when they reappear (through abilities like Elise's E - Rappel , Master Yi's Q - Alpha Strike , etc.)

changes.title: W - Bastion
changes.text: BONUS ARMOR: 10/12.5/15/17.5/20% of Taric's armor ⇒ 10/11/12/13/14% of Taric's armor

attackDamageGrowth.method: Archived baseline with subsequent official stat changes applied
